checks.rule: OS mapping is topographic and is not intended to represent property boundaries
HMLR plans use OS MasterMap as mapping basis
Scaled measurements must not be inferred from title plans
Enlarging a map does not improve original survey accuracy
Copying/reducing/enlarging a plan can distort accuracy
1:1250 relative 95pct confidence is under +/-0.9m for well-defined detail
1:1250 absolute RMSE is under +/-0.5m for well-defined points
Mapping capture category must be retained as a precision gate
